title: I finally released a free demo of my AI-assisted god simulator GODSHIFT! Would love some honest feedback
author: Icy-Initiative-4319
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on GODSHIFT, a god simulator inspired by games like WorldBox, and I finally released a free demo!

You can create civilizations, watch them grow, develop technologies, fight wars, and occasionally cause some chaos with divine powers and monsters.

I've been developing the game with the help of AI, mainly using Claude Code for programming, debugging and implementing my ideas. I handle the game design, testing and decisions about how everything should work.

The demo includes the Sleeping Giant map, a selection of monsters and powers, and the full civilization simulation. There's no time limit, so you can mess around as much as you want.

I'm still improving the game, especially the visuals, animations and overall simulation, and I'd really appreciate some honest feedback.

If you give it a try, let me know what you think! Even criticism is welcome, it helps me figure out what needs improving.

**Free demo (Windows):** https://fanfan77.itch.io/godshift

Thanks to anyone who takes the time to check it out! :)
